system.description:
Hearth Wisdom compiles old wives' tales rather than established fact — the unsystematic body of knowledge accumulated by peasants, traders and others who lack servants or learning. It covers which plants and animals are safe to eat, which herbs aid cooking or relieve minor aches, the signs of coming weather, rules of thumb for domestic disputes, and folk wisdom about the dangers of the night.

The Dark Medieval counterpart to modern folk learning, Hearth Wisdom stands opposite the formal scholarship of Academics and Theology.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
